user.title: Floorplan Studio
user.description: Adds the Floorplan editor to the sidebar and the floorplan card to your dashboards. Open **Floorplan** in the sidebar afterwards to draw or import your home.

init.title: Floorplan Studio
init.description: Choose whether the Floorplan editor is in the sidebar. The floorplan card on your dashboards always keeps working. Hidden? Then open the editor at the address /floorplan-studio.
